content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm having trouble resetting the Hours Counter from the interface using a button. The counters work fine and reset as expected when I trigger the Reset All button. However, if I use the Interval Reset button, the counters reset but then freeze, requiring me to upload the profile again to restore functionality. Any assistance would be appreciated. I've attached the profile file in a zip archive. Interface password: password Best regards [user_name]
I've tested your [product_name] program and your [product_name] project on my [product_name] with [version_no]. I wasn't able to reproduce the error you mentioned. See the attached screen recording.

I searched the forum and found a similar topic: 'Hours Counter issue?'. Reading through that topic, it appears that the error only occurs in firmware [version_no] for [product_name] [version_no]. I updated my firmware in 08/2022 to [version_no], which resolved the issue. It looks like the bug was fixed in the newer firmware.
Thanks for the helpful feedback and information. I'll update my firmware and check if the issue is resolved. Best regards [user_name]
Check out this forum topic for download links to the latest [product_name] software and firmware. You'll find the necessary link there.

I've just updated the firmware on all my [product_name] devices using SD cards, and they're all working perfectly now. An extra benefit is that my data logging, which was previously unreliable, is now consistently working with the new firmware. Thanks again for the excellent support. Kind regards [user_name]
That's great to hear! Thank you for sharing your feedback. This could be helpful for other users too.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a problem where the Hours Counter on their [product_name] devices would freeze after an interval reset from the interface, requiring a software upload to recover functionality. Investigation showed this was related to a firmware bug in [version_no] and did not happen on the newer firmware. Upgrading to the latest version solved both the counter freeze and issues with data logging, highlighting the importance of keeping firmware updated for stable device performance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the Hours Counter to reset properly and continue operating after either interval or full reset via the interface. They also anticipate reliable data logging performance from their devices.
